# TestScript for 29-feature-toggles — shell completion pruning.
# Inactive gated flags and commands never reach completion candidates; the
# baseline flags do.

# Isolate the conventional XDG config tier from the host machine.
env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg

# 1. Default: gated flags and the gated command are absent.
exec serve __complete export --
stdout '"value":"--listen"'
stdout '"value":"--cache"'
! stdout '"value":"--http3"'
! stdout '"value":"--allow-insecure"'
exec serve __complete export ""
! stdout '"value":"admin"'

# 2. Enabling the features reveals them in completion.
env SERVE_FEATURES=http3=true,admin-api=true
exec serve __complete export --
stdout '"value":"--http3"'
exec serve __complete export ""
stdout '"value":"admin"'
